# Matt Pocock skills

Project-local copies from [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills),
licensed under [MIT](LICENSE). The root `skills-lock.json` records each skill's
upstream path and content hash.

All 38 skills discovered by the upstream installer are included: 25 published
engineering/productivity skills, 9 in-progress skills, and 4 miscellaneous skills.
Each directory contains its `SKILL.md` and any supporting files.

Run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` once to configure issue tracking, triage labels,
and documentation preferences. Installation alone does not configure these or
activate hooks.

These copies live in `.github/skills` as requested. The current `skills` CLI
defaults to `.agents/skills` for GitHub Copilot; when updating, preserve this
location and avoid leaving duplicate installations.
